name: Studio Collab
description: Work on one shoot as a team: ratings, flags, colour labels, keywords, develop edits, team collections, stages and who is on which photo. Teammates connect directly, so changes arrive within a second; a shared folder your studio already syncs (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Syncthing, a NAS) or a relay you host yourself keeps the record and catches up whoever was away. End-to-end encrypted with a room code; no server of anyone else to pay for.
author: Anthony Reimche

permissions.reason: Teammates connect to each other directly. To find each other they leave sealed, unreadable notes on public Nostr relays and WebTorrent trackers (you can turn this off in the panel). It also connects to the relay address your studio enters, after you allow it.
